title: Finite evaluation of the unary completed pullback comparison
statement: For d,m,hl,o,z and every f:X→Y and integral constructible L, evaluate reduction of pullValue followed by pullReduction, then evaluatedPull. The result equals reductionEvaluation at the datum pullback of L followed by the full finite-Tor inclusion of pullIso. These are the comparisons of [def-sf-integral-projection-evaluation-factors] and [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data]. No tensor, support, or projection map occurs.

proof.text: The unit characterization of pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic identifies it with the leftAdjointUniq used by sixFunctorFinitePullbackModel. Apply the datum pullProjection equation, cancel the finite pullback and representative isomorphisms, and use naturality of reductionEvaluation across pullValue. The finite-Tor inclusion leaves arrows unchanged.

theorem integralProjectionPullEvaluation
    (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k)) (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left) :
    (evaluation (C := C) (E := E) m X).map
        (((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.mapIso
          (FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.pullValue D C E d.higher hl f L) ≪≫
          FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.pullReduction D C E o z
            f.hom.left L.obj).hom) ≫
      (evaluatedPull d m f L).hom =
    (reductionEvaluation d m X ((d.higher.integral.pull f).obj L)).hom ≫
      (finiteTorConstructible C.l E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) X.obj.left).ι.map
        (pullIso d m f L).hom
